sources.text:
## Decision and project

Decision DEC-001 selects Beacon Evidence Hub as the evidence organization tool for Project Atlas. The decision was approved on October 12, 2026. It concerns internal compliance operations, not investment selection or expected returns.

## Approval and accountability

Elena Brooks, Head of Compliance, approved DEC-001. Priya Shah prepared the evidence workflow assessment supporting the recommendation. Preparing an assessment is a different responsibility from approving the decision.

The Project Atlas charter records the project's lead and executive sponsor. Those project roles do not establish who approved DEC-001; this decision record is the authority for that approval.

## Decision and project

Decision DEC-004 approves the completeness-review process for Project Atlas. Before evidence is marked ready for review, the team must run LedgerCheck's required-evidence checks and resolve missing items. Evidence records and their review ownership remain organized in Beacon Evidence Hub.

## Approval and accountability

Elena Brooks approved DEC-004 on October 14, 2026. Priya Shah prepared the completeness-review assessment. Maya Chen coordinates Atlas delivery; Daniel Ortiz is the executive sponsor. Their project roles do not make them approvers of DEC-004.

## Team and tools

Maya Chen and Priya Shah work on Project Atlas. The team uses the fictional Beacon Evidence Hub to organize compliance evidence and the fictional LedgerCheck tool to check evidence completeness.

## Tool responsibilities

Beacon Evidence Hub organizes compliance evidence records and their review ownership. Its operational owner is the Compliance Office.

LedgerCheck checks whether required compliance evidence is complete. Priya Shah maintains its evidence-completeness rule catalogue. LedgerCheck does not organize the evidence repository itself.

Harbor Access Register records access-request ownership and review outcomes. Its operational owner is the Data Platform team.

Signal Lineage Board records internal risk-reporting dependencies and source lineage. Its operational owner is the Risk Analytics team.

Project charters identify which projects use these tools. A tool owner, rule maintainer, project sponsor, and decision approver are different roles.

# Atlas completeness-review decision

Document ID: DOC-008
Company: Aster Vale Investments (fictional)
Version: 0.1-draft
Updated: 2026-10-16
Source owner: Compliance Office (fictional)

All entities and events in this document are fictional training data.

## Purpose

Project Atlas is Aster Vale Investments' compliance evidence modernization project. Its goal is to organize records showing that internal investment operations follow documented processes. Atlas covers evidence collection, review ownership, and audit preparation. It does not select investments or forecast fund performance.
